output.explanation: Expanded surfaces because its two renderer adapters hide substantial owned state and lifecycle machinery. The central diagram now emphasizes the mounted component tree, with editor-runtime detailing checkpoint synchronization and canvas-runtime detailing reactive models, selection ownership, anchors and routing. Their shared selection-ownership relationship is explicit. Checked the pinned checkout's mounting code, adapters, stores, selection tools and controller boundary. Clarified that shape bodies/hooks supply measurements, native selection only tracks drag IDs, and CanvasRuntime cleanup unsubscribes and disposes routing through its editor setter rather than a general dispose method. Workspace, sessions, domain and backend remain unchanged as surrounding context. Preserved every existing edge, relocating only endpoints affected by the expansion.

MappingEditorRuntime: native editor / semantic checkpoint adapter
src/features/mapping/tldraw/MappingEditorRuntime.ts
|
`-- MappingEditorRuntime (owned by MappingEditorCanvas's editor effect)
    |-- Borrowed Editor, controller and NativeSelectionOwnership
    |-- Private projection state
    |   |-- projected: node ID -> last projected shape
    |   |-- checkpoint: current canvas revision ID
    |   `-- syncing / settling / navigating / dirty / pendingProjection flags
    |-- Subscription/disposer list
    |   |-- Controller driver registration: settle() and undo(redo)
    |   |-- Controller snapshot listener -> publish relevant changes
    |   |-- Editor document side effect: mappingCheckpoint changed
    |   |   `-- -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint(); publish without recording
    |   |-- Editor store listener: shape/selection changes -> dirty flag
    |   `-- Idle editor tick -> settle dirty geometry, then pending projection
    |-- hydrate(): replay checkpoint references into native history
    |   `-- -> controller.editorHistory(); materialize current shapes only
    |-- publish() / writeShapes(): semantic snapshot -> native shape projection
    |   |-- Create/update/delete shapes; order edges and side panels
    |   |-- Selected shapes = application membership + native drag IDs
    |   `-- Store mappingCheckpoint with shape diffs; add history stopping points
    |-- settle(): complete native geometry at the semantic boundary
    |   |-- Compare live shapes against projected cache
    |   |-- Grid moves + supported diagram clones -> move/duplicate operations
    |   |-- Pane positions/sizes -> display geometry and manual/fixed policies
    |   |-- Native selection -> drag IDs only, NOT content membership
    |   `-- -> controller.commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
    |-- undo(redo): complete and settle before native history navigation
    |   |-- Transfer transaction boundary -> reject; use workspace coordination
    |   `-- -> Editor.undo/redo -> checkpoint side effect restores domain history
    `-- dispose(): complete + settle; detach driver and observers in reverse order

CanvasRuntime: per-surface reactive render models and geometry
src/features/mapping/tldraw/CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx
|
`-- CanvasRuntime (owned by MappingEditorCanvas, NOT by CanvasSession)
    |-- Borrowed session/controller; editor reference held in an atom
    |-- SelectionToolBridge
    |   |-- NativeSelectionOwnership: application/native claim + drag IDs
    |   |-- Pointer suppression/type, move target, cancel/escape callbacks
    |   `-- -> registered for Editor tools; ownership shared with editor adapter
    |-- Reactive read-model collections: Models<T>
    |   |-- Per-ID atoms: grids / floating panes / side panels / edges
    |   |-- publish() structurally shares equal branches; clears absent values
    |   `-- sync(): controller snapshot -> projected models and endpoint identities
    |       |-- Cached display-node registry, previous snapshot and edge IDs
    |       `-- -> routing.sync(); anchors.retain(layout keys)
    |-- LocalAnchorStore
    |   |-- Endpoint identity -> atom of layoutKey + local measured rectangle
    |   |-- -> useLocalAnchors supplies rounded DOM measurements
    |   `-- Layout mismatch invalidates; camera/culling does not erase anchors
    |-- NativeRoutingStore
    |   |-- Obstacle-owner atoms + per-owner layout-keyed measurements
    |   |   `-- World obstacle computations -> borrowed Editor page transforms
    |   |-- ConnectionRouter + settled arrows + completed-result atom
    |   |-- Optional worker and request state
    |   |   |-- One in-flight job; newest pending job; serial ID + geometry key
    |   |   `-- Publish only current result; worker failure -> synchronous fallback
    |   |-- drawAll(): dragging -> previews; idle -> worker or local router
    |   `-- dispose(): terminate worker, clear jobs and completed/settled results
    |-- routedEdges computed model
    |   |-- Edge endpoints -> anchors or estimates + native page transforms
    |   `-- -> routing.drawAll(); consumed by native connection rendering
    |-- Focused edge/node atoms + computed node connections
    |-- Undo/escape availability, interaction, catalog and alternatives atoms
    |-- CanvasActions callbacks installed by MappingPocSelectionCanvas
    |   `-- -> application commands, workspace undo, jump and conversation actions
    `-- Lifecycle: connect() subscribes; setting editor undefined disposes routing
